rationale: The Court is likely to reject fugitive tolling as atextual given Congress’s express “does not run” rule in § 3624(e) and the warrant/summons trigger in § 3583(i), with Bowles-style separation-of-powers concerns reinforcing a narrow holding. Expect a principal dissent from Justice Alito (likely joined by Justice Kavanaugh) framing tolling as an interpretation of “service” and invoking anti-profiting-from-wrongdoing background principles.
